text: I'm so sorry to be bothering you at this hour. I'm looking after my grandson tonight, he is 6. His temperature is 38.2 and he says his throat is sore, but he is still drinking his juice and water alright. I wanted to ask how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I should be giving a boy of his age. I don't want to get it wrong and his mother is away. Apologies again, I know you must be busy with more important things.
